character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A highly detailed, full-body pixel art character sprite of the 'Bárbaro' (Barbarian/Berserker) class, inspired by the bottom-right character in the selection roster. The character stands in a wide, powerful front-facing battle stance against a solid, neutral grey background. The sprite follows a classic 16-bit to 32-bit retro JRPG aesthetic with bold outlines and rich pixel shading. The barbarian features a muscular, bare-chested build adorned with a leather harness belt across his torso, studded leather wrist bracers, and a ragged fur-trimmed loincloth with sturdy leather boots. He wears a rugged iron helmet with prominent curved horns pointing outward, framing an aggressive, weathered face with a strong jaw. In his right hand, resting angled upwards, he grips a massive double-edged battleaxe (greataxe) with a notched steel blade and worn wooden haft. The sprite maintains the proportional scale and chibi-heroic proportions of the party roster, using detailed dithering on muscular shadows, rough iron textures, and fur to convey a savage, battle-hardened warrior.
